title: Piercing Frame Solo MaxMakeup #004 (맥시멀리스트 얼굴 컷 · P25 집중형 · 맥시멀리스트 · 피부톤 에보니 브라운 · 재질 얼굴만 · 체형 BBW bombshell · 금속 혼합 · 메이크업 스페인플라멩코글램)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult woman — DEEP EBONY BROWN SKIN, a rich dark complexion with warm brown undertones, mid 40s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, a bold, commanding expression — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight pieces — a big mixed-metal segment ring in the lobe, three smaller mixed-metal rings above it, two thick mixed-metal bars and two small mixed-metal studs up to the top; one small mixed-metal stud sits in the right ear; four mixed-metal pieces in a row along the outer half of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two small mixed-metal rings pass through the left nostril and a thick mixed-metal septum ring hangs below the nose; a mixed-metal hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a mixed-metal snake-bite ring beside it and a small mixed-metal ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a mixed-metal Medusa stud sits above the lips; a mixed-metal labret stud and a small mixed-metal ring sit on the chin; three small mixed-metal studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small opals set into the metal. All jewelry is real mixed metal (yellow gold, silver, copper and rose gold, alternating piece by piece), sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
